title: Grateful Dead Live at Fillmore East on 1970-11-16
lineage: SBD > MR > Revox deck (model unknown) - 10 inch 1/4 track Reel @ 7.5ips > Revox B77 playback > Alesis Masterlink ML9600 > CD > EAC > Cool Edit 2000 > CD Wave > shntool > mkwACT > SHN (seekable)

ai_review.summary: Pristine soundboard capture of the legendary Fillmore East 11/16/70 set, highlighted by a blazing The Other One, soaring Uncle John’s Band and guest‑filled jams.
ai_review.review: The recording is an excellent‑to‑pristine soundboard transfer that preserves a surprisingly clear mix despite some channel quirks. Musically the show shines with standout moments such as The Other One, Uncle John’s Band, China Cat > I Know You Rider and a fiery Hard To Handle featuring Steve Winwood on organ, while a few reviewers find Truckin’ or the guest‑led NFA vocal section weaker. Overall the performance is praised for its energy, historic guest appearances and solid set flow despite lingering setlist‑order confusion.

ai_rating.rationale: Most reviewers rate the show 4–5 stars, praising both the superb soundboard quality and strong musical moments; only a few note minor performance or setlist issues, leading to a high‑confidence rating around 4.4.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Pristine clarity noted by multiple reviewers; interesting mix with some channel imbalances (Bobby up front left, Jerry right), but overall clean, A‑to‑D transfer from first‑gen 10" reels. No major dropouts.

standout_songs: China Cat > I Know You Rider
show_quality.setlist_flow: Generally praised for its energetic jam flow, though several fans note confusion over the exact set order and mislabeling of the venue/date; guest segments (Traffic/Hot Tuna) add unique flavor.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Mix places Jerry farther back on right channel; no specific performance critique beyond general band praise.
band_member_comments.Phil: Mentioned goofing off‑mic during Frozen Logger and brief banter before Mama Tried.
band_member_comments.Bob: Sings Frozen Logger off‑mic; vocal presence noted in that snippet.
band_member_comments.Keys: Steve Winwood (guest) provides organ on Hard To Handle and through Not Fade Away; Will Scarlet adds harp; Pigpen largely absent, occasional Traffic percussion noted.
